unica.view.reason: Base logical-node projection with closed props/branches/items sections is implemented; the requested can section is computed for metadata kinds and the Configuration root from the closed operation registry, while uncomputed can kinds and the limits section answer typed unsupported_section; richer domain projections remain incomplete.

unica.apply.reason: Retained atomic publication is proven for props.set, the metadata member collections, predefined items and relations; the code planner (code.insert/code.replace) and the XDTO planner (valueType/objectType/property/type operations) plan through the same staged state; object.create, object.remove and help.create stage the template files, the owner registration and the embedded help facet through the same state; the DCS planner runs the schema text transforms (fields, parameters, filters, selection, queries, calculated fields, totals, variants, structure) over the staged template; roles (right.set with restrictions, role.create), subsystems (create, content, child subsystems) and vendor-support switches plan over the staged files too; forms (form.add/create/set/remove and the definition-driven element, attribute, command and event edits) plan through the form engine's shared definition core; mxl.set decompiles, edits and recompiles the spreadsheet through the shared cores; event.implement plans through the event planner with developer-style event addresses; templates are staged as their own descriptors with owner registration.

unica.resolve.reason: Both directions of the bridge answer exactly, and a line-based source also answers its line range; a tree-based source names the absence instead of guessing, so a caller who needs a position inside XML still searches the file itself.

unica.search.reason: Bounded literal BSL search supports Configuration and resolved metadata-object subtrees; regex and symbol search remain incomplete.

unica.check.reason: Workspace admission and logical readability are implemented; the closed validation profiles (cf, cfe, form, dcs, mxl, role, subsystem, interface) run the native validators over the logical node and the meta profile runs the typed metadata validator, with the verdict returned in data.

unica.diff.reason: Same-kind bounded structural JSON diff supports closed paths/sections filters; revision-bound pagination remains incomplete.

unica.run.reason: Runner 1.0 vocabulary: seven supported closed schemas, push delete only; source synchronization, upload without implicit database apply, apply/reset and target create remain unavailable.

unica.docs.reason: Platform-help and development-standard search are implemented, while configuration documentation remains unsupported.

extensions.list.reason: Installed-extension operation via the pinned runner: non-executing preview, configuration/arguments/provider revision fence, bounded typed result; infobase facts are attested by the provider.

extensions.set.reason: Installed-extension operation via the pinned runner: non-executing preview, configuration/arguments/provider revision fence, bounded typed result; infobase facts are attested by the provider.

infobase.create.reason: Runner 0.11 does not implement the required runner 1.0 semantics; refused before source admission or process execution.

push.reason: Only explicit delete of an installed extension is implemented; source sending and its generation contract remain unavailable.

pull.reason: Runner 0.11 does not implement the required runner 1.0 semantics; refused before source admission or process execution.

make.reason: Building a CF or CFE from workspace sources is implemented as previewApply over v8-runner make: the output is confined to the workspace before the runner is called, .epf and .erf are refused as unsupported in v0.13, the preview names the artifact kind, source set and output without publishing, apply is fenced by ifRev built from the project file, the declared composition, the arguments and the output digest, and Unica verifies the built file by size and digest rather than trusting the provider.

download.reason: Working/database main configuration and named extension export use v8-runner provider selection, non-executing preview, revision-fenced apply, and independent artifact verification.

upload.reason: Runner 0.11 load implicitly runs update_db_cfg, whereas target upload must stop at the working configuration.

infobase.dump.reason: Full DT export uses v8-runner provider selection, non-executing preview, revision-fenced apply, and independent artifact verification.

infobase.restore.reason: DT restore states which irreversible change is allowed, uses the same provider selection and revision-fenced apply as the exports, and attributes the resulting infobase state to the provider because it is not verifiable without the platform.

launch.reason: Terminal launch of a 1C client is implemented as published: the call launches at once, dryRun is an optional non-executing preview from v8-runner, no revision fence; closed args are clientMode, execute, waitForExit and waitTimeoutMs, and the answer names the selected platform without exposing the command line.

apply.reason: Runner 0.11 does not implement the required runner 1.0 semantics; refused before source admission or process execution.

reset.reason: Runner 0.11 does not implement the required runner 1.0 semantics; refused before source admission or process execution.

unica.task.get.reason: Durable compatibility Task state projection is implemented.

unica.task.result.reason: Bounded durable compatibility Task result projection is implemented.

unica.task.cancel.reason: Idempotent durable compatibility Task cancellation is implemented.
